title: Fee Waivers Granted by a Wanderlane Traveller Club Tier
content:
The programme office records two waiver entitlements against a Wanderlane Traveller Club tier, and both are properties of the tier rather than of any one booking.

The first is whether the agency service fee is waived on bookings made while holding the tier. The second is the number of change fees waived each membership year across the portfolio.

| Tier | Agency service fee on bookings | Change fees waived each membership year |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | not waived | 0 |
| Wanderlane Silver | not waived | 0 |
| Wanderlane Gold | not waived | 1 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | waived | 2 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | waived | 4 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | waived | 8 |

The two entitlements are not granted together. Wanderlane Gold carries 1 waived change fee a membership year while its bookings still bear the agency service fee, and the waiver of that service fee begins at Wanderlane Platinum, which carries 2 waived change fees a membership year. Wanderlane Titanium carries 4 and Wanderlane Ambassador 8, both with the agency service fee waived.
